notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Dear friends, it's time for our game update!

Have been added:

 Hardcore Mode
New challenging game mode, with unique achievements

 New Quest in Act 5
A new quest is available in the VIP lounge of Act 5

 Vending Machine{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/4d1ddbb6fe686363d117678c1f2cb4aeb4e8ee35.pngNow in the vending machines you can buy consumables that make life easier for the protagonist

 New Achievements
There are 7 new achievements in the game (not counting “Hardcore” mode achievements)

 Сheat Codes Book
Bailey's store has a new item - a book of cheat codes, buying it resets your character's talents and stats

 Underground Tournament Act 2
The NPC with the Underground Tournament Act 2 is back

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we have fixed some bugs:


 Fixed defeat when beating Cato in “realism” mode

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we have fixed the most problematic bugs and added a new game mode:

Story mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/89a0afa7a49413a937178c081d5b900c67b5a5f3.png
The game has a new mode - “ Story Mode” in this mode you will not lose progress when losing in the tournament

Ai correction in Critical-Strike
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/d0c3d5117722c0cd6f418c2437686bae1096446b.png
We fixed Ai in Critical-Strike, now CT bot will not skip moves during active bomb.

Hidden quest underground tournament act2/act55
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/9dec9d6ec635ea70dddb84e79817ed80b94d26f2.png
Due to bugs related to the underground tournament, we have hidden this quest. In the future, we will replace it with a new quest.

Surrender Button for Battle and Craft 2
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/25faf121d24670028b281a128695323074482ca5.png
It is now possible for a player to end a match early during a tournament


 Now in the second act, the player does not lose progress on defeats

 Now in the second and first act between matches, the stress is relieved

 Alerts with negative stress statuses are now closed automatically

 Critical-Strike bug with Bailey's training has been fixed

notes.title: Bug Fixes 1.0
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we have fixed some bugs:


 Fixed the bomb defuse bug in manual CS mode
 Fixed the soft lock when taking a call from C.T in CS (final of act4)
 Fixed the Act 1 Game over, now you can lose in Act 1 and get the “Game over” achievement
 Changed the talents of the opponents


We're already working on other bugs, AI improvements, and new content

notes.title: Release day has come!
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we are glad to inform you that the long-awaited day has arrived! Today at 3 p.m. CEST the game will be available!
Our team will be releasing content updates and fully supporting the game in the future. 
If you encounter bugs or have suggestions, message us in discord: 
https://discord.gg/9MmPW3xAa9

notes.title: Prologue release, and the Portuguese language!
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we are happy to inform you that the prologue release has happened. 
You can try the new Demo version on this page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3217120/Esports_History_Prologue/

We'd love to see your feedback through reviews on the prologue page.

Also, Esports History has been translated into Portuguese!

Since we are 7 days away from the release of our game, we are launching an event on our Discord channel:
https://discord.com/invite/9MmPW3xAa9
Each nickname written in the discord chat will be added to the game within 4 days (30.09.2024). 
You will find all the details of the event in our Discord.

Thank you for waiting for our game!

notes.title: Devlog 5 + Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear friends, it's time for a new Devlog, but before we start it we'd like to make a few announcements.

The first news is the exact release date - the full Esports History version will be released on Steam on October 3, 2024.

The second news is the announcement of Esports History: Prologue, a few weeks before the release we are going to release a free version of the beginning of the game which will contain all new mechanics from the full game. 
We hope you try the new version of the first acts and like it.

Our team has been working at a record pace for the last few months, even though it's not easy we realize that the release is inevitably coming, and that inspires us.

In the last 40 days we've done:

New dynamic background for locations

 Now under the locations will be a dynamic background that changes depending on the time of day.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/db079d3046338f45e68f85ded63bfe9886ba2b8c.gif

UI Update

 Dialog window redesign
 Adding emotions for character sprites
 Updating interfaces
 Adding animations for interfaces
 Fonts update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/578fb7249bbf07d0f180e1251135e09e6df85b06.gif

Menu for new mini-games
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/da0d4ea0d7625e6d349228c5e7b4881cbf0c61f5.gif

New Stress System

 Several negative stress-related statuses have been added to the mini-games.
 Players can receive both minor debuffs and severe ones, the higher the stress the greater the risk of receiving a serious debuff.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/92093610aed5340bc0efbe12a2e6a7bf2e07a650.gif

Portable game consoles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/63fc1db4d31748c925e4c619059885b911ce0bad.gif

Added automatic and semi-automatic modes for new mini-games

 The new minigames have the option to play in new auto modes similar to what you saw in the demo, but additionally, the player has the option to play in hardcore manual mode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/18beff8e88f7f6586d31592c9bbc82f4b7c9340e.gif

New game save system

 The game will now save the game on its own.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41189226/583c24e5f276bf734473eb3502bbc585bf5a246a.png

New experience system designed for 30 levels
Animated intro between Act 2 and Act 3 

We are also working on game balance, localization, and bug fixes. 
The release date is chosen so that we have enough time to fix as many bugs as possible and release a quality version of Esports History. 

Thank you very much for waiting for our game!
